message:
I fixed the yen receipt in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It always divided the amount by 100 and showed two decimals, so 500 JPY came out as `¥5.00`. It now treats JPY as having no minor unit and prints `¥500`.

The yen receipt test passes, and so do the cart-total and invoice-render tests. I did not get a full `npm test` result. `node --test` hung in this environment, so I ran those test files one at a time.

`formatMoney` is shared by receipts, invoices and the cart, so JPY amounts in those places now show without decimals too. If any caller stores yen multiplied by 100, that would now display wrong. I found no yen tests or code besides the receipt test.
